decision: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
fact: The following Power Unit elements have been used: 5th Internal Combustion Engine (ICE) 5th Turbo Charger (TC) 5th Motor Generator Unit - Heat (MGU-H) 3rd Energy Store (ES) 3rd Control Electronics (CE) The following Restricted-Number Components have been used: 5th Gearbox Cases and Cassettes (GBX C & C) 5th Gearbox Driveline, Gear Change Components and Auxiliary Components (GBX DL) All elements above were replaced without the approval of the FIA Technical Delegate during Parc Fermé.
offence: Breaches of Articles 28.2, 29.2, 40.3 and 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the Race from the pit lane.
reason: The penalty is imposed in accordance with 40.9 The Power Unit elements used are in excess of the permitted number for the 2023 Championship season were used. This is a breach of Art. 28.2 and incurs a grid penalty. The RNC components and auxiliary components used are in excess of the permitted number for the 2023 Championship season were used. This is a breach of Art. 29.2 and incurs a grid penalty. As the PU elements and RNC and auxiliary components were changed without prior approval of the Technical Delegate in Parque Fermé this is not in accordance with Article 40.3 and Art 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations. The competitor is therefore required to start the race from the pit lane per article 40.9 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
